name: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade / CH-3X Lightning Grenade

values.meaning: Magic Damage (per bounce, upgraded R form)
values.binNote: HeimerdingerR.EUltBaseDamage/EUltDamage carries this rank-3 value; the wiki's ratio (0.6 AP) matches the calc's 0.6 coefficient.

mechanics.claim: The grenade deals damage to all enemies near the impact, not just one target.
mechanics.quote: detonates upon impact, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies

mechanics.claim: If the grenade hits an enemy champion, nearby friendly turrets gain full beam charge, letting them use their stronger beam attack sooner - a damage buff for the turrets, not Heimerdinger's own damage.
mechanics.quote: all ''{{ai|H-28G Evolution Turret|Heimerdinger|icononly=yes}} {{ai|H-28Q Apex Turret|Heimerdinger|turrets}}'' within 1000 range of the impact gain 100% beam charge

mechanics.claim: Enemies hit at the exact center of the grenade's impact are additionally stunned, but this is CC and does not itself add damage.
mechanics.quote: Enemies hit at the center of the grenade's impact are also {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: The upgraded R version bounces 3 times, but each enemy champion can only be damaged once per cast (subsequent bounces don't re-damage champions), though they can still be slowed/stunned again.
mechanics.quote: Enemy champions can only be damaged once per cast, but can be {{tip|slow|slowed}} and {{tip|stun|stunned}} multiple times if circumstances permit.

mechanics.claim: The spell can be blocked by spell shields.
